finding: The v3 K562 source build and source evaluation passed, but are not accepted into the replacement chain.

The first HCT116 source-build attempt materialized one filtered Parquet file at a time and failed closed at batch 40 of 109 when process peak RSS reached 17.713 GiB against the 17.5 GiB internal ceiling.
A second identical-arithmetic attempt using Arrow's system allocator failed closed at batch 80 of 109 when process-tree RSS reached 18.28 GiB against the 18 GiB external guard.
Neither HCT116 attempt published a final donor directory. Both stale lock files were removed only after their recorded PID no longer existed.

correction.aggregation: Apply the unchanged sparse target and response aggregation to each record batch and sum the resulting float64 arrays.
correction.scientific_contract: Target eligibility, source rows, total UMI, response coordinates, split assignments, arithmetic, reconstruction tolerance, operators, nulls, and gates remain unchanged.
